answers.ask: Tell me about American Swedish Historical Museum and whether it fits my wedding
answers.text: The American Swedish Historical Museum in Philadelphia fits 150 guests: it seats up to 230, is all-inclusive, and has an outdoor ceremony space. Its Google rating is 4.7 from 101 reviews, which cover the whole place, not only weddings. One wedding review praises the grounds and attentive staff.
